Firmus and its advisors on Thursday were contemplating cutting the size of the IPO and reducing the price per share from A$11 each to A$8.25, according to local media reports. Bookbuilding closed earlier Thursday and potential investors were told in a term sheet reviewed by Reuters "the joint active bookrunners will provide further information in relation to the offer." SOME INVESTORS SAY THEY ARE WARY OF VALUATION The deal's initial term sheet had said indicative offers for the IPO were already above the deal's size. But some potential investors told Reuters they were cautious about the company's burgeoning valuation, ability to execute on its ambitious growth plans and hefty debt pile. Demand for Firmus stock from overseas investors was weaker than expected for the IPO, the reports said, which was to be a landmark transaction for Australia's subdued capital markets. Shares of Maas closed down 22.4 per cent on Thurday, after falling much as 30 per cent in intraday trading, its weakest level since May 6. The company lost about A$517 million ($359.52 million) in market. It is valued at A$1.79 billion. Maas was questioned by the Australian Securities Exchange (ASX) over the share price plunge. The company said in an exchange filing that speculation over whether the IPO would proceed had weighed on sentiment, adding it was not aware of any undisclosed information that would explain the trading "The selloff reflects a legitimate derating of the embedded value of its Firmus stake, but the magnitude is overdone," said Emanuel Ajay Datt, managing director of fund manager Datt Group. A cut in Firmus' offer price to A$9 from A$11 would reduce the value of Maas' holding by about A$75 million, Datt said, adding that the loss was modest relative to the company's market value decline on the day. Firmus' $5 billion IPO was to be Australia's largest new share sale in nearly three decades, behind only top telco Telstra's roughly $10 billion float in 1997. ($1 = 1.4380 Australian dollars)

Source: Reuters

item.title: インド株式市場・引け＝続落、インフレ懸念で主要指数32ヵ月ぶり安値
item.description:
Bharath Rajeswaran Vivek Kumar M
[８日 ロイター] - インド株式市場は続落して引け...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
インド株式市場・引け＝続落、インフレ懸念で主要指数32ヵ月ぶり安値 19:44 配信

Bharath Rajeswaran　Vivek Kumar M

[８日 ロイター] - インド株式市場は続落して引けた。ＳＥＮＳＥＸ指数が３２カ月ぶり安値に沈んだ。原油価格の高騰、世界的な国債利回り上昇、ルピー安を背景にインフレ懸念が強まった。前日は中央銀行によるタカ派的利上げに圧迫されていた。

ＮＳＥ指数は１．６４％安の２万２２３１．８、ＳＥＮＳＥＸ指数は１．４４％安の７万１５９３．２４で終了。ＮＳＥ指数は１８カ月ぶりの安値で引けた。

外国人投資家の売りが加速、過去９日間では４６９９億ルピー（４８億６０００万ドル）を売り越した。年初来の資金流出は過去最大の３０４億ドルに達した。

ＳＥＮＳＥＸ指数は年初来で約１５％下落している。一方でＭＳＣＩ新興国株指数は人工知能（ＡＩ）関連株への資金流入を追い風に２３％上昇している。

ＮＳＥ指数とＳＥＮＳＥＸ指数は先週に一時持ち直したものの、再び売られ過ぎの水準に戻った。相対力指数（ＲＳＩ）は３０を下回り、売り圧力の強さを示している。

主要１６業種は全て下落。小型株指数は２．３％、中型株指数は２．５％それぞれ下げた。

指数構成比率上位３銘柄のうち、ＨＤＦＣ銀行は１．５％安、ＩＣＩＣＩ銀行は０．６％安、リライアンス・インダストリーズは２．５％安だった。

エクイノミクス・リサーチの創業者で調査責任者のＧ・チョッカリンガム氏は「市場は現在、相互に関連する複数の要因から圧力を受けている。インフレ懸念による世界的な国債利回りの上昇、ルピー安、外国人投資家の売り越しの継続といった要因は、根本的に全て原油価格の高止まりに関連している」と指摘した。

FAST

Oct 8 : Technology companies and utilities are increasingly exploring ways to make power-hungry data centers more flexible in when and how they consume electricity, helping ease the strain on US power grids as AI-driven demand surges. The strategy, called "demand response", involves data centers temporarily reducing or shifting electricity use during periods of peak demand or grid stress, and is gaining traction as a way to reduce the need for costly grid upgrades and new power generation. It's a tool that states around the US, federal agencies and market operators are increasingly exploring, said Lauren Shwisberg, a principal at energy think tank RMI. WHY DOES DATA CENTER FLEXIBILITY MATTER?

US data center electricity use could rise from about 177 to 192 terawatt-hours in 2024 to between 383 and 793 TWh by 2030, according to the Electric Power Research Institute. Meanwhile, data centers surveyed by the group reported peak power reduction potential of 10 per cent to 30 per cent, depending on facility type, with some hyperscalers going even higher, according to Arin Kaye, EPRI technical leader. A study by Duke University's Nicholas Institute estimated that greater flexibility from data centers could save between $40 billion and $150 billion in capital investments over the next decade. It could also help data centers connect to the grid more quickly, as regulators and grid operators explore faster pathways for facilities willing to curb electricity use during periods of high demand. WHERE DO EFFORTS STAND? So far, the "demand response" strategy for data centers has mostly been deployed through pilot projects or one-off agreements. OpenAI, for example, recently agreed to cut the electricity it draws from the grid by up to 1 gigawatt from a planned 3.2-gigawatt facility in Georgia during periods of grid stress. This, however, is gradually evolving into a broader push. Federal regulators in June ordered grid operators to consider new rules for connecting large power users to the grid, including new pathways for facilities offering this flexibility to connect faster. Last month, Alphabet's Google, NVIDIA and Emerald AI launched an initiative called the AI Energy Management Alliance, aimed at advancing the deployment of "flexible" data centers. WHAT ARE THE KEY CHALLENGES? Experts say scaling up the strategy will require changes on both sides. Data centers need to figure out how to adjust power consumption without disrupting customers, while utilities and grid operators need to develop tariffs, market incentives and faster interconnection pathways that reward that flexibility. "Demand response can materially soften peak impacts, but scaling curtailment agreements across hundreds of new facilities will demand significant capital expenditure and coordinated policy frameworks," said Alexander Kheder, analyst with BMI, a unit of Fitch Solutions.

Source: Reuters

item.title: Germany's Uniper sale risks leaving money on table
item.description: Berlin is re-privatising the energy group, which it rescued in a €14 bln 2022 bailout. Its ambition to keep the company’s disparate parts under one roof rests on shaky logic about energy security. But a breakup would be a far more lucrative strategy for taxpayers.
item.dc:creator: Liam Proud
item.content:encoded: When Germany rescued Uniper (UN0k.DE) in 2022, making a profit wasn't the priority. The goal was to stabilise a company that was, and still is, central to the energy needs of Europe's largest economy. Now, as Berlin re-privatises Uniper, it could in theory more than break even. But insisting on keeping the disparate portfolio of businesses together risks a discounted valuation. Uniper is one of those companies that no one would invent if it didn't already exist. It spans Swedish nuclear power, German gas-fired plants, an energy-trading unit and other businesses. When Russia invaded Ukraine it suffered two blows. Uniper faced collateral demands on derivative trades, and when Russian gas was no longer flowing it had to pay exorbitant prices for replacement supplies. Berlin stepped in with €13.5 billion of capital injections , and bought shares from the group's then-controlling Finnish owner Fortum (FORTUM.HE) for around €500 million. That left the government with a 99% stake. Now it's time to get out. Officially, the government is pursuing two options: either a majority sale or an initial public offering, retaining a 25% holding in either scenario. Floating looks tough given a subdued European market, which means the roughly 75% stake sale seems more likely. Reuters has [USN:L8N45S0FP TEXT:"reported"] that the runners and riders in the bidding include Apollo Global Management (APO.N) , Norway's Equinor (EQNR.OL) , Daniel Kretinsky's EPH, and two consortia. One pairs KKR (KKR.N) and Germany's RWE (RWEG.DE) and another involves Brookfield and the Canada Pension Plan Investment Board. On paper, a breakup is the best way to maximise value. Nordic players would probably go for the assets in their home region, while RWE or buyout barons could take the local German generation business, for example. It's hard to know what these parties would bid, but one way to think about the possible breakup value is to use brokers' sum-of-the-parts valuations. ODDO BHF analysts value Uniper's equity at €17.7 billion, after adding up the value of its component parts, including net cash and deducting other liabilities. On that basis, the government could bank a tidy profit based on the paper value of its holding - especially since it has already received around €3.5 billion from Uniper, through state aid paybacks and dividends, according to Reuters. But the chances of taxpayers seeing that much value seems remote. That's because Berlin wants to keep a one-quarter stake to retain influence over major decisions, and appears to oppose a breakup, meaning Uniper will merit a hefty conglomerate discount. A finance ministry spokesperson said Berlin wants to ensure the viability of the company as a whole, given its importance to country's energy supply. That doesn't seem like a great argument. First, Swedish nuclear power has little to do with German energy security. As for the local assets, governments have many ways to influence producers without owning large stakes, including through regulation. Saving Uniper wasn't about making a profit, but that doesn't mean Berlin has to leave money on the table. Follow Liam Proud on Bluesky and LinkedIn . Apollo Global Management has submitted a non-binding offer for Uniper, Reuters reported on October 7, citing two people with direct knowledge of the matter. Potential suitors had until September 21 to submit indicative bids for the German state-owned energy firm, which was taken over by the German government in 2022 under a €13.5 billion ($15.1 billion) bailout. In total, Berlin has received around €3.5 billion from Uniper since the bailout, including state aid paybacks and dividends. Norway's Equinor, and a consortium consisting of KKR with German utility RWE, have also submitted bids, Reuters reported citing one of the two people. Suitors are expected to be informed about whether they can proceed to the next round in the coming weeks, according to the report, which cited a third person involved in the talks. ($1 = 0.8938 euros) CONTEXT-NEWS

item.title: iFood está em negociações avançadas para comprar empresa de benefícios Caju, diz Valor Econômico
item.description: A plataforma de delivery iFood está em negociações avançadas para adquirir a companhia de benefícios Caju, de acordo com reportagem do jornal Valor Econômico publicada nesta quinta-feira.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A plataforma de delivery iFood está em negociações avançadas para adquirir a companhia de benefícios Caju, de acordo com reportagem do jornal Valor Econômico publicada nesta quinta-feira. O acordo pode ser fechado até o final de outubro, afirmou o Valor Econômico, citando fontes. Procurado, o iFood informou à Reuters que não comenta rumores de mercado e que "segue focado em investir no crescimento sustentável do seu ecossistema". A Caju também disse que não comenta rumores de mercado.

item.title: Morning Bid: Wall Street winces at bond squeeze
item.description: Stock markets finally stalled on Wednesday and early Thursday as the bond crunch ground on, with the latest Federal Reserve minutes showing most policymakers in September saw more interest rate rises ahead.
item.dc:creator: Mike Dolan
item.content:encoded: Stock markets [USN:L6N45T0JD TEXT:"finally stalled"] on Wednesday and early [USN:L4N45T1LT TEXT:"Thursday"] as the bond crunch ground on, with the latest Federal Reserve minutes [USN:L6N45T0TQ TEXT:"showing"] most policymakers in September saw more interest rate rises ahead. Markets have scaled back the Fed tightening horizon a bit in recent weeks but still see three more hikes over the coming year, starting in December. Reinforcing the message from the Fed minutes, Fed Governor Christopher Waller [USN:L6N45T15S TEXT:"said on Thursday"] that additional rate hikes will likely be needed to lower inflation to the Fed's 2% target - although he said there was "flexibility" about the pace. There was [USN:L8N45T0F3 TEXT:"some relief"] in bond land on Wednesday after the latest 10-year Treasury auction went off OK, but not before yields hit another 24-year high earlier in the day. There are 30-year bonds up for grabs later on Thursday too. While Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent has downplayed the latest bond moves as global rather than US-specific, the so-called "term premium" in 10-year debt that accounts for investor uncertainty beyond Fed interest rates has risen again to its highest in 12 years. Having set new records earlier in the week, Wall Street stocks [USN:L6N45T0JD TEXT:"pulled back"] on Wednesday, with the focus shifting to the upcoming earnings season and the latest round of circular financing in the AI world between chipmakers and their customers. Reports overnight detailed the latest debt financing between Broadcom and OpenAI, following reports this week that SpaceX and Nvidia [USN:L6N45S1CQ TEXT:"are arranging"] chip finance of up to $40 billion. Broadcom and Anthropic too are discussing debt financing on a similar scale. The rise of debt in the AI buildout, and what appears to some like "vendor financing", raises the stakes for earnings season updates on the durability of the boom. Taiwan chip giant TSMC's quarterly revenue once again [USN:P8N3NB03R TEXT:"beat lofty forecasts"] on Thursday, while South Korea's Samsung underlined the scale of things there as it [USN:P8N44T045 TEXT:"reported"] a more than 700% annual rise in operating profit. Yet even that [USN:L4N45T1LT TEXT:"wasn't enough"] for the market, which knocked Samsung shares down more than 1% on some indications that the pace of growth and chip price rises were set to cool. Chart of the day The so-called term premium on 10-year US Treasury yields, the added compensation for risk demanded by investors for holding the bond to maturity, rose this week to its highest level since 2014, according to the New York Fed's model. The climb in nominal Treasury borrowing rates to 24-year highs over recent months has mostly been attributed to a rethink of the Fed's interest rate horizon, and this has been reflected in the rise of real inflation-adjusted yields. Long-term inflation expectations have remained relatively stable. But the spike in the term premium reflects broader concerns about rising debt levels, political risks and the uncertainties surrounding government financing over the longer term. Today's events to watch US weekly jobless claims (8:30 a.m. EDT) US 30-year bond auction (1 p.m. EDT) Regional Fed presidents Neel Kashkari and Alberto Musalem speak Before you head off, listen to the latest episode of the Morning Bid daily podcast, where we discuss the latest flurry of interconnected financing deals funding the AI buildout. Oct 8 : Lindsey Vonn has been named in the US Alpine ski team for the 2026-27 World Cup season despite uncertainty over her future in the sport as she recovers from surgery following a heavy crash at last February's Milano Cortina Olympics. The U.S. team said in a statement that all named athletes had qualified based on existing Alpine criteria. Despite her injuries, Vonn was ranked 12th overall last season and fifth in the final downhill standings.  She was also the highest ranked US female skier in Super-G. The three-times Olympic medallist, who will be 42 this month, said in April she was unsure if she would return to competitive ski racing after suffering a complex tibia fracture in a crash during an Olympic downhill race on February 8.

item.title: Indian opposition protest police action against lawmakers, push for poll chief's resignation
item.description: Indian opposition groups demonstrated for a third day on Thursday, protesting police action against Congress party leaders and demanding the resignation of the chief election commissioner over a controversial revision of voter lists.
item.dc:creator: Praveen Paramasivam, Haripriya Suresh
item.content:encoded: Indian opposition groups demonstrated for a third day on Thursday, protesting police action against Congress party leaders and demanding the resignation of the chief election commissioner over a [USN:L4N45K0E7 TEXT:"controversial revision"] of voter lists. Opposition parties, their student units, and the "Cockroach" youth movement have been holding [USN:L1N45O03D TEXT:"almost daily demonstrations"] seeking Chief Election Commissioner [USN:L4N45K0DB TEXT:"Gyanesh Kumar's"] resignation. They have accused Prime Minister Narendra Modi's ruling Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) of using a revision of voter lists to fix them in its favour, in collusion with its appointees, including Kumar. Kumar has not commented but the Election Commission and the BJP have denied the allegations. The protests present a new political challenge to Modi midway into his third term, just months after similar demonstrations led by the self-named Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) forced the [USN:L1N43R02E TEXT:"resignation of his education minister"] over exam paper leaks. Visuals from news agency ANI showed dozens of Congress supporters staging a protest march on Thursday in the southern state of Telangana, while the opposition Rashtriya Janata Dal organised a similar demonstration in the eastern state of Bihar. Hundreds of supporters of the CJP youth movement also protested in tech hub Bengaluru, many of them holding posters that said, "Every name counts, Every vote matters" and "Stop the Murder of Democracy". "I think voting right is the most basic point of democracy ... People who actually want to vote, who actually care about the future of India, they are just being (denied) voting rights," Khushi Shrivastava, a 22-year-old architecture student who attended the Bengaluru protest, told Reuters. On Wednesday, Congress accused police of using "brute force" to briefly detain party leader Rahul Gandhi, his sister Priyanka Vadra, and other lawmakers as they [USN:L1N45T0ER TEXT:"tried to reach"] the Jantar Mantar protest site in New Delhi. Delhi Police said the allegations were being used to "defame" the force. "We are on the ground and, as officers, we also ensure that every kind of legal duty is followed and no illegal, unnecessary actions take place," senior police officer Shrishti Pandey told ANI. BJP spokesperson Gaurav Bhatia said the allegations were "being levelled by an irresponsible, anarchist opposition". The claims had "no base, not an iota of evidence", he told reporters at a media briefing on Thursday.

item.title: スイス中銀、金融政策の調整不要 インフレ率は目標範囲内＝副総裁
item.description:
Emma Farge
[マルティニー（スイス） ８日 ロイター] - スイス国立銀行（中央銀行）のマルタン副総裁は８日...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
スイス中銀、金融政策の調整不要　インフレ率は目標範囲内＝副総裁 19:18 配信

スイス国立銀行（中央銀行）のマルタン副総裁、3月19日撮影 REUTERS/Denis Balibouse

Emma Farge

[マルティニー（スイス） ８日 ロイター] - スイス国立銀行（中央銀行）のマルタン副総裁は８日、国内のインフレ圧力は高まっているものの、金融政策を調整する必要はないとの見解を示した。

マルタン氏はスイス南西部マルティニーで開かれた会合で、ここ数カ月のインフレ率上昇は主に、中東紛争に伴う原油価格の上昇によるものだと説明した。

９月のインフレ率は１．０％に加速し、２年余りぶりの高水準となった。これを受け、市場では中銀が１２月に政策金利を現在の０％から引き上げるとの観測が強まった。

ただ、マルタン氏は、スイスのインフレ率は他の多くの国と比べて低く安定しているとして、政策方針を変える必要はないと述べた。「インフレ率は物価安定の目安とする０─２％の範囲に十分収まっている。このため現時点では金融政策を変更する必要はないと考えている」と語った。

「もちろん、これらの予測には依然として大きな不確実性がある。特に、イランでの戦争がまだ終結しておらず、それに伴う地政学的な緊張があるためだ」とも述べた。

また、インフレの影響が経済の他の分野に波及する兆候も見られないとした。「問題は、例えば企業が賃金上昇や原油高による将来の物価上昇を見越して、価格や賃金をどの程度引き上げるかだ」と指摘した。

「現時点でこうした２次的な影響は見られず、極めて心強い。賃金と物価がスパイラル的に上昇し始めると、インフレがさらなるインフレを招くようになり、問題が生じる」と述べた。

今後も２次的な影響の兆候が見られなければ、インフレ率は現在の水準近辺にとどまるとの見通しを示した。

スイス経済は現在「非常に好調」だとも述べた。スイスフランはここ数カ月で下落したものの、インフレ調整後では２０２０年以降、安定していると続けた。

ロイター 関連ニュース アングル：ＡＩ企業、臨床試験の成否をシミュレーションで予測 コラム：焦点は金利上昇の「質」、日米金利環境の変化とドル円相場＝尾河眞樹氏 焦点：ベトナムの銀行の70億ドル増資計画、海外勢の出資拡大の好機に アングル：欧州国債、財政懸念で選別進む　フランスは売り・ドイツに資金逃避 アングル：米政府、借り入れコスト抑制へ選択肢狭まる　歳出削減以外ならインフレ加速も 最終更新: 10/8(木) 19:18 ロイター

item.title: Boots’ new owners bring needed retail tonic
item.description: After decades of trading between buyout shops and pharmacy groups, the UK drugstore operator has found a long-term owner in Canada's Weston family. The $8.9 bln price tag looks fair – provided the buyer can unlock growth by sprucing up its stores and boosting online sales.
item.dc:creator: Jennifer Johnson
item.content:encoded: While a stalwart of the UK high street, Boots' ownership structure has seen constant change. Buyout shop Sycamore Partners only [USN:L3N3PP1Y8 TEXT:"acquired"] the group as part of its purchase of Walgreens Boots Alliance last year. Now, some two decades after it was taken private by KKR (KKR.N) and Stefano Pessina, the group appears to have found a long-term owner in Canada’s Weston family. The $8.9 billion price (£6.7 billion) tag looks fair, provided the buyers can give Boots' recovery a shot in the arm. The family's track record – owning grocery chain Loblaw and Shoppers Drug Mart, Canada's largest pharmacy group – suggests it’s a good fit for Boots, which has suffered from the endless ownership changes and being a small part of the much larger U.S. entity. While former parent Walgreens did invest in Boots' flagship stores and rationalise the estate, bankers [USN:L6N42P0PR TEXT:"told Breakingviews"] that the UK group's locations still need an overhaul. The Westons seem to have factored that in, offering a big discount to the $10 billion valuation that the Financial Times reported as a potential sale price in June. Besides sprucing up tired shops, the Westons and co-owner Fairfax Financial (FFH.TO) may be hoping to revive Boots' fortunes by boosting online sales and offering more high-margin health and beauty products. Assume Boots grows sales by 3.5% this year – in line with the previous two – and that the new regime is able to boost that rate to an average of 5% over the following three years, bringing revenue to £9 billion in 2029. Apply a margin of 7%, in line with the Weston family's Loblaw, take off tax, and Boots should bring over £470 million in net operating profit after tax in 2029. This should give the new owners an annual return of just over 7%, in line with the sector's cost of capital, per NYU Stern . These might not be the sort of rapid returns private equity shops are after, but it would still be a respectable outcome for a long-term investor. The Westons have bought a trusted brand, which is half the battle in retail. Now it’s a question of being patient enough to maximise its potential. Follow Jennifer Johnson on Bluesky and LinkedIn . Canada’s Weston family agreed on October 7 to buy Boots from Sycamore Partners and the Pessina family, alongside Fairfax Financial, in an $8.9 billion deal including assumed debt. Wittington Investments, a Weston holding company, said it would purchase Boots' retail operations in the UK and Ireland, Boots Opticians and the No7 Beauty Company, as well as its Thailand and franchised businesses. Fairfax is expected to hold 50% of Boots' equity after closing, while Wittington will have operational control. The Weston group owns Canadian grocer Loblaw and Shoppers Drug Mart, Canada's largest health and beauty retailer. The British side of the Weston family is the majority shareholder of Primark-owner Associated British Foods. CONTEXT-NEWS

item.title: PepsiCo slashes forecast, deepens cost cuts as N.America recovery drags
item.description: PepsiCo warned on Thursday that growth and margin recovery in its key North American market was taking longer than planned and said it would pursue additional cost cuts to offset sluggish demand for its snacks and beverages.
item.dc:creator: Anuja Mistry, Alexander Marrow
item.content:encoded: PepsiCo (PEP.O) warned on Thursday that growth and margin recovery in its key North American market was taking longer than planned and said it would pursue additional cost cuts to offset sluggish demand for its snacks and beverages. Faced with high input costs, inflation hit to demand and the growing threat of GLP-1 weight-loss drugs, the company is pursuing record productivity savings in its turnaround efforts launched after activist investor [USN:L4N45S0OW TEXT:"Elliott Investment Management"] took a roughly $4 billion stake a year ago. PepsiCo's third-quarter revenue exceeded market expectations and the company adjusted its 2026 organic revenue forecast to about 3% from a prior view of 2% to 4%, but flagged slow progress and profitability struggles in North America. "In North America, we remain committed to improving growth and core operating margin," said CFO Steve Schmitt in prepared remarks. "However, it is taking more time than we planned. Therefore, we expect North America's core operating margin performance to remain under pressure in the fourth quarter." PepsiCo's core operating margin dropped 35 basis points in the third quarter from a year ago and was down 25 basis points year to date at 16.5% of revenue. In December, after discussions with Elliott, PepsiCo said it was [USN:L4N3XE1KL TEXT:"targeting a 100-basis-point uptick"] over three years. The company also cut its fiscal 2026 forecast for core earnings per share after adjusting for currency fluctuations to an increase of 1% to 2%, compared with previous expectations for the low end of the 4% to 6% range. The challenge is industry-wide. Packaged food makers such as General Mills (GIS.N) , McCormick (MKC.N) and Conagra Brands (CAG.N) are spending more on promotions and affordability initiatives to revive demand while contending with higher input costs. PepsiCo, whose shares were up about 1% in early trading, is expanding its range of [USN:L6N45R0VX TEXT:"high-protein products"] to tackle the GLP-1 threat and is now promising extra productivity savings. "Additional structural cost reduction actions are being identified and will be implemented in the coming months to help fund investments that aim to accelerate organic revenue growth and mitigate the impacts of rising input cost inflation," CEO Ramon Laguarta said in a statement. PepsiCo's international business continues to perform well, but North America weakness, where third-quarter volumes in food were flat and dipped 2% in beverages from a year ago, is a persistent pain point. "The beverage business continues to disappoint, and we expect PepsiCo will continue to be a source of share to both Coca-Cola and Keurig Dr Pepper." said Nik Modi, analyst at RBC Capital Markets. "PepsiCo will have to fully refranchise its beverage business or it will continue to lose share." The company cut prices by up to 15% on products such as Lay's and Doritos in February, but last month said it would [USN:L6N45G101 TEXT:"raise some chip prices"] to keep pace with input cost inflation. CEO Laguarta has bought some goodwill with the international numbers, but the pressure he is under is high and rising, said David Wagner, head of equity and portfolio manager at PepsiCo investor Aptus Capital Advisors, noting that patience from the board and activists is finite. "Next couple of quarters need to show real North American inflection, or the pressure moves from 'deliver the turnaround' to 'explain why you're still the right person to lead it'," he said.

item.title: 米中間選挙、トランプ支持者の投票意欲低い＝ロイター／イプソス
item.description:
Nathan Layne Jason Lange
[８日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Nathan Layne　Jason Lange

[８日 ロイター] - ロイター／イプソスの世論調査によると、２０２４年の米大統領選で民主党のハリス前副大統領を支持した有権者は、トランプ大統領を支持した有権者よりも、今年１１月の中間選挙に対して投票意欲があることが分かった。共和党にとって悪材料となる。

また、５日に終了した６日間の世論調査では、男性有権者の間で民主党支持へのシフトが見られた。トランプ氏の２４年大統領選勝利の柱となった層における共和党支持低下を示している可能性がある。

２４年の大統領選でハリス氏に投票した有権者の約４８％が、中間選挙での投票に「非常に熱心」だと回答。これに対し、トランプ氏に投票した有権者で同様の回答をしたのは３０％にとどまった。

トランプ支持者の大多数は共和党に投票する予定であり、ハリス支持者も同様に民主党に投票する傾向がある一方で、２４年の大統領選におけるトランプ支持者の態度はそれほど明確ではなく、１３％が中間選挙で誰に投票するかまだ決めていないと答えているのに対し、ハリス支持者で同じように答えたのは７％にとどまっている。

調査は全米規模で４５０６人の成人を対象にオンラインで行われた。

もし今日選挙が行われたらどちらに投票するかという質問に対し、男性は共和党よりも民主党を４３％対３９％で選んだ。民主党の４ポイントのリードは、トランプ政権２期目で最大の差。男性は２５年には一貫して共和党を支持していたが、８月以降はおおむね民主党を支持している。

item.title: New US charges to be filed in case against Venezuela's Maduro, prosecutors say
item.description: New charges will be filed on Thursday in the US criminal case against ousted Venezuelan President Nicolas Maduro, the Manhattan US Attorney's Office said on Thursday.
item.dc:creator: Luc Cohen
item.content:encoded: New charges will be filed on Thursday in the US criminal case against ousted Venezuelan President Nicolas Maduro, the Manhattan US Attorney's Office said on Thursday. Details of the new charges were not immediately available. A US official told Reuters on Wednesday that Maduro and his wife Cilia Flores were expected to face [USN:L6N45T18A TEXT:"new charges"] over the alleged torture of Americans held in Venezuela. Flores, 69, and Maduro, 63, were captured by the US military on January 3 in their Caracas home and brought to New York to face an indictment accusing them of abusing their positions of power to allow drug traffickers to ship cocaine. The surprise raid [USN:L1N3Y4092 TEXT:"ended"] the socialist Maduro's 13 years in power in oil-rich Venezuela , which has since boosted cooperation with the US under the leadership of Maduro's former Vice President Delcy Rodriguez. Maduro and Flores [USN:L6N3Y607X TEXT:"pleaded not guilty"] to the drug charges and have been held at Brooklyn's Metropolitan Detention Center since their capture. Their trial is scheduled for June 1, 2027. FLORES SEEKS RELEASE FROM JAIL Separately, Flores is expected to appear in a US court on Thursday to urge a federal judge to release her from jail for health reasons while she awaits her drug trafficking trial next year. At a hearing set to start at 10:30 a.m. EDT (1430 GMT) in Manhattan federal court, Flores' lawyers are expected to ask US District Judge [USN:L1N3Y8014 TEXT:"Alvin Hellerstein"] to grant bail so their client can undergo a cardiac procedure and recover in a more comfortable environment. The lawyers proposed moving her to a residence in the New York City area with round-the-clock private security, and said she is not a danger to the community. The lawyers also said Venezuela's government, which the US [USN:L1N418020 TEXT:"authorized"] to pay Flores' and Maduro's legal fees, would cover the costs. Prosecutors in the Manhattan US Attorney's Office oppose Flores' release. They said Flores has received adequate medical care at the detention center, and if released poses an "extreme" risk of flight and danger to the public, including possible witness intimidation. Prosecutors also said other judges have found it unfair to let some criminal defendants pay for their own out-of-jail supervision, because defendants of lesser means cannot afford it. Hellerstein's bail decision will not affect Flores' trial or potential punishment. If convicted, she faces a mandatory minimum 40-year sentence. Flores was Venezuela's attorney general and led its National Assembly before becoming first lady. US prosecutors say she took hundreds of thousands of dollars in bribes from a large drug trafficker.

item.title: US states label abortion drugs a 'public nuisance' in bid to curb access
item.description: Three Republican-led US states are testing a novel legal argument as they seek to stem the flow of abortion pills to residents who can still obtain them from out-of-state providers despite their abortion bans.
item.dc:creator: Daniel Wiessner
item.content:encoded: Three Republican-led US states are testing a novel legal argument as they seek to stem the flow of abortion pills to residents who can still obtain them from out-of-state providers despite their abortion bans. Louisiana, Alabama and Arkansas filed two lawsuits last week claiming that medical providers are creating a "public nuisance" by mailing abortion drugs over state lines and that New York, California and Massachusetts have aided that conduct by adopting [USN:L1N3OU1C6 TEXT:"shield laws"] protecting abortion providers from out-of-state prosecution and civil liability. Experts said the lawsuits represent an unprecedented attempt to use public nuisance law, traditionally applied in environmental pollution and [USN:L6N4480WF TEXT:"other public harm cases"], to curb access to abortion pills. They also mark the first direct challenge to state shield laws by states that ban abortion. The novel claims come as anti-abortion groups and officials search for ways to combat the growth of telehealth prescribing of abortion drugs protected by shield laws. About 91,000 abortions were provided in 2025 via telehealth to patients in states with total abortion bans, a significant increase from 74,000 in 2024, according to the Guttmacher Institute, an abortion rights advocacy group. New York Attorney General Letitia James and her counterpart in Massachusetts, Andrea Joy Campbell, both Democrats, said in separate statements that the Republican-led states were seeking to impose their abortion bans on other states and punish doctors for providing legal health care. The office of California Attorney General Rob Bonta did not immediately respond to a request for comment. CURBING PILL ACCESS Nearly half of US states have banned or severely restricted access to abortion since the US Supreme Court in 2022 [USN:LUN2QW00Q TEXT:"overturned Roe v. Wade"], the 1973 ruling that had legalized abortion nationwide. Women in those states have had to travel out of state or rely on telehealth prescribing and mailing of pills, driving [USN:L6N40W0ZE TEXT:"a surge in medication abortion"], which accounted for 65% of US abortions in 2023, according to the Guttmacher Institute. Medication abortion is a two-drug regimen consisting of mifepristone followed by misoprostol used to terminate a pregnancy within the first 10 weeks. In response, Republican-led states have [USN:L1N3YS15U TEXT:"sued or indicted doctors"] and [USN:L1N44T0TE TEXT:"filed lawsuits"] challenging the initial federal approval of mifepristone in 2000 and subsequent rules expanding access, which are pending. The Supreme Court in May [USN:S0N40Z03Z TEXT:"refused a request by Louisiana"] in one of those lawsuits to block telehealth prescribing and mail delivery of mifepristone nationwide while that case proceeds. And [USN:FWN42C0QU TEXT:"a safety review"] by the US Food and Drug Administration has drawn criticism from some anti-abortion groups for moving too slowly. The agency on Wednesday, in a filing in the case that reached the Supreme Court, said it expects to complete its review by March 2027. Most major medical groups, and the FDA at various times since 2000, have said that mifepristone is safe and effective when taken as directed and that serious adverse events are rare. PUBLIC NUISANCE A public nuisance claim generally targets activities that unreasonably interfere with public health and safety, such as blocking a road, polluting a waterway or emitting noxious fumes. States have invoked public nuisance law in recent decades in a broader range of cases involving tobacco, opioids, climate change, vaping, and social media use by children. Bringing a public nuisance claim can have various advantages, including the ability to seek wide-ranging court orders requiring defendants to abate nuisances. It also allows plaintiffs to sidestep the typical legal requirement of proving harm to individuals, both to establish standing to sue and to win cases. But the states' claims are unusual because they involve abortion drugs that have repeatedly been approved for sale by federal regulators and they focus on the states' ability to enforce their abortion bans rather than public safety, some experts said. "That is not protecting their residents from harm, nor is it in line with typical public nuisance claims," said Linda Goldstein, senior counsel at the Center for Reproductive Rights, an abortion rights group. The new lawsuit against states with shield laws was filed directly with the US Supreme Court, which can take up disputes between states that have not been heard in lower courts but routinely turns away such cases. The second lawsuit , which names nearly 30 individual medical practitioners and groups as defendants, was filed in Louisiana federal court. Both lawsuits include a variety of other legal claims. The offices of the attorneys general in the three states that filed the lawsuits did not respond to requests for comment. Two nonprofits that are defendants in the second lawsuit, A Safe Choice Network and Cambridge Reproductive Health Consultants, did not respond to requests for comment. In the court filings, the states said that both the shield laws and the alleged conduct of out-of-state providers were classic examples of public nuisance because they are aimed at thwarting state abortion bans adopted to protect public safety. If states "enacted laws goading their residents into sending anthrax, fentanyl, or mail bombs into Plaintiff States ... there would be no question that Plaintiff States could sue to abate those public nuisances," they said in the Supreme Court filing.

item.title: 米農業債務が過去最大、政府統計は実態を過小評価の可能性
item.description:
P.J. Huffstutter
[シカゴ ８日 ロイター] - 米国では農家の運転資金の借り入れが過去最大となってい...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米農業債務が過去最大、政府統計は実態を過小評価の可能性 19:02 配信

写真は米カンザス州キングマンの小麦畑。5月13日撮影。REUTERS/Emily Schmall

P.J. Huffstutter

[シカゴ ８日 ロイター] - 米国では農家の運転資金の借り入れが過去最大となっているが、伝統的な金融機関以外による融資や取引先による信用供与が増え、連邦政府が農業債務の全容や動向を把握しきれない部分が生じている。米農務省の当局者がロイターに明らかにした。

農家は農産物価格の低迷と生産資材費の高止まりで、何年も採算の厳しい状況が続いている。最近では、中国など主要な輸出先と米国との貿易摩擦で輸出市場が混乱し、苦境に立たされている。イラン戦争も肥料や燃料のコストを押し上げている。

農家の破産申請が増える中、一部の銀行は融資基準を厳格化しており、農家は別の資金調達先を探している。農務省の最新推計によると、インフレ調整後の米農業債務は２０００年の約３０００億ドルから今年は６０５０億ドル超へと２倍以上に増え、過去最大となった。

ただ、ロイターの調査によると、この数字は農家の債務を過小評価している可能性がある。農家は資材供給業者や農業協同組合、農機メーカー、金融テクノロジー企業など、従来型の金融機関以外からの借り入れを増やしている。政府がこうした債務を網羅的に把握するのは難しい。

当局者によると、農務省はこうした債務をより正確に把握するとともに、農業部門の資金繰りの悪化が経済全体に影響している可能性を探るため、調査研究に着手する。

農務省の２５年の統計では、「個人・その他」の区分の債務は４５０億ドルだったが、カンザス州立大学のジェニー・イフト教授（農業金融）によると、実際にはその２─３倍に上る可能性がある。

＜経済全体への波及＞

農業経済調査会社メリディアン・アグリビジネス・アドバイザーズのパートナー、ウェズリー・デービス氏によると、前シーズンは米商業農家の約半数が、運転資金を取引先や伝統的な金融機関以外からの融資に頼っていた。前年に比べ約１０％増えたという。

農務省経済調査局のジェフリー・ホプキンス次長代行は「経済の他の分野に影響が波及する恐れのある領域がないか」を調べていると明らかにした。ホプキンス氏はデータ不足により健全な負債と問題のある負債の判別が困難だった０７─１０年のサブプライム住宅ローン危機に言及した。

ロイター 関連ニュース 焦点：テスラ、ロボタクシー「サイバーキャブ」で試す規制の限界 アングル：減量薬ブームでスリムに、米男性が薄毛・たるみケアで「理想の自分」完成へ コラム：なお残る米9月利上げの公算、 ＦＯＭＣ議事要旨が示唆 焦点：トランプ氏の中国産鉱物脱却、国内供給不足で27年期限は困難か コラム：広がる米「大衆富裕層」、消費主導経済の底力に 最終更新: 10/8(木) 19:02 ロイター

item.title: Bank of England's Pill says central banks must focus on inflation
item.description: Bank of England Chief Economist Huw Pill said on Thursday that central banks had to keep their focus on fighting inflation against the backdrop of rising bond yields in financial markets around the world.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Bank of England Chief Economist Huw Pill said on Thursday that central banks had to keep their focus on fighting inflation against the backdrop of rising bond yields in financial markets around the world. "I think (we are) in an environment where there are inflationary pressures at present, and we need to address them, we need to make sure monetary policy is resolutely on that," Pill told a conference organised by consultancy Eurasia Group and LSEG. "We need to ensure the financial system is functioning to allow the transmission of monetary policy to make that happen." Pill and two other Monetary Policy Committee members voted to raise interest rates in September. A majority on the MPC preferred no change as they awaited clearer signs of the impact of the Iran war on inflation but Governor Andrew Bailey and others said the time for a rate hike might be approaching.

LONDON, Oct 8 : British online fashion retailer ASOS said on Thursday that a cybersecurity breach earlier this week had exposed some customers' personal information, including names and contact details, according to its initial investigation. It said the hacker also had access to "certain non-personal account related information," but no payment card information or account passwords, ASOS said in an email to customers. "We discovered that an unauthorised party gained access to an ASOS employee account by impersonating a trusted contact to obtain log in credentials," ASOS said. "Those credentials were then used to access information on certain third-party platforms used by ASOS."

It said the affected platforms were immediately locked down, ensuring that no further information could be accessed, adding that the ASOS website and app were safe to use throughout, and remain safe to use. ASOS said it is working with the relevant law enforcement and regulatory authorities. Shares in ASOS were up 3 per cent, paring losses for the week to 8 per cent. So-called "social engineering" operations, where hackers impersonate workers to gain access to companies' computer networks, are prevalent. British companies and institutions have been increasingly hit by aggressive and regular cyber and ransomware attacks in recent years. The British Library, a blood testing service, the London Underground, Marks & Spencer, the Co-op and Jaguar Land Rover are some that have suffered months of disruption due to such breaches.

item.title: Kingspan hit with €40 million EU fine for misleading data on Slovenian deal
item.description: Irish building materials maker Kingspan was fined €40 million ($44.7 million) for providing incorrect and misleading information during an investigation into its abandoned acquisition of a Slovenian rival, EU antitrust regulators said on Thursday.
item.dc:creator: Yun Chee Foo
item.content:encoded: Irish building materials maker Kingspan (KRX.I) was fined €40 million ($44.7 million) for providing incorrect and misleading information during an investigation into its abandoned acquisition of a Slovenian rival, EU antitrust regulators said on Thursday. The sanction followed a four-year investigation by the European Commission, which is the European Union competition enforcer, and underscores its tough policy against such infringements of EU merger rules. Kingspan said it would challenge the EU fine. "We look forward to appealing the decision in full," the company said in an email. EU antitrust chief Teresa Ribera said companies must adhere to merger rules. "When companies withhold or distort the truth, they undermine a system that protects fair competition for everyone. There can be no compromise on disclosure and transparency. If they fail to do so, we do and will act firmly," she said in a statement. Kingspan announced its plan to acquire Trimo in 2021 but scrapped the deal in April 2022 after the EU antitrust watchdog warned that the acquisition could jack up prices and reduce quality. The Commission subsequently opened an investigation in November 2022 to examine whether Kingspan had provided incorrect and misleading information. Its Thursday decision said the company provided misleading information about how it tracks penetration rates for mineral fibre sandwich panels and the availability of bidding data, as well as incorrect information about board members' involvement in certain matters. Such breaches can cost companies fines up to 1% of their total global turnover. ($1 = 0.8940 euros)

item.title: 台湾輸出、ＡＩ需要で9月も過去最高 米国向け前年比106％増
item.description:
Faith Hung Jeanny Kao
[台北 ８日 ロイター] - 台湾財政部（財務省）が８日発表した９月の輸出額は、前年同月比６０．９％増の８７２億２０００万ドルとなり、８月の８２４億ドルを上回った。人工知能（ＡＩ）チップ・技術への需要に支えられ、２カ月連続で月間過去最高を更新した。

item.content:encoded:

[フランクフルト ８日 ロイター] - 欧州中央銀行 （ＥＣＢ）理事会メンバーのスレイペン ・オランダ中銀総裁は８日、ユーロ圏の家計インフレ期待はの短期的には上昇したが長期は依然２％の中銀目標付近で安定していると述べた。

item.title: Energy shares lift TSX despite higher yields
item.description: Canada's main stock index inched higher on Thursday, with gains in energy stocks offsetting the drag in financials as rising bond yields and oil prices kept investors wary of inflation and higher interest rates.
item.dc:creator: Avinash P
item.content:encoded: Canada's main stock index inched higher on Thursday, with gains in energy stocks offsetting the drag in financials as rising bond yields and oil prices kept investors wary of inflation and higher interest rates. The Toronto Stock Exchange's S&P/TSX Composite Index (.GSPTSE) was up 0.24% at 35,125.61 points by 09:57 a.m. ET (1357 GMT), after logging its steepest one-day drop since June 5 on Wednesday. Oil prices rose more than 4%, lifting the energy sector (.SPTTEN) 1.8% and extending its yearly gains to nearly 50%, making it the best-performing major TSX sector in 2026 "TSX has benefited mostly from the conflict in the Middle East which has driven up oil prices," said Allan Small, senior investment advisor of the Allan Small Financial Group with iA Private Wealth The heavily weighted financials sector (.SPTTFS) fell 0.5% as climbing yields reinforced expectations that interest rates will remain higher for longer The yield on the benchmark US 10-year Treasury note rose to 5.2796%, but was slightly below the multi-decade high it had scaled on Wednesday. Its Canadian counterpart rose on Thursday "The number one negative right now is that yields are up," Small said Elevated bond yields kept investors on edge as they reassessed the outlook for monetary policy and interest rates Markets are pricing in at least one quarter-point rate hike from the Bank of Canada before the end of the year, according to data compiled by LSEG Traders also expect one 25-basis-point interest rate hike from the US Federal Reserve before 2026 ends, according to LSEG data Materials sector (.GSPTTMT) edged up 0.8%, after touching a three-month low in the previous session as gold prices steadied Among stock moves, Richelieu Hardware (RCH.TO) jumped 11.9%, topping TSX after the specialty hardware distributor reported a rise in third-quarter revenue

item.title: UK court refuses permission to appeal in diesel emissions lawsuits against carmakers
item.description: London's High Court on Thursday refused claimants permission to appeal against its July decision which broadly found in favour of some of the world's biggest carmakers over diesel emissions.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: London's High Court on Thursday refused claimants permission to appeal against its [USN:L8N43C12G TEXT:"July decision"] which broadly found in favour of some of the world's biggest carmakers over diesel emissions. Judge Sara Cockerill, who earlier this year rejected most of the allegations that certain diesel vehicles were fitted with unlawful "defeat devices" that led to higher emissions, said the claimants would have to apply directly to the Court of Appeal.

item.title: ドイツ連立政権、改革の迅速な実施を確認 「歴史的な試練」受け
item.description: [ベルリン ８日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[ベルリン ８日 ロイター] - ドイツ連立政権の上層部は、支持率が過去最低水準に落ち込み、極右政党「ドイツのための選択肢（ＡｆＤ）」が伸長する中、改革を迅速に実施することを誓った。ロイターが８日に議員宛てのメッセージを入手した。

メルツ首相率いる保守派ブロックと中道左派の社会民主党の各院内代表が署名したメッセージには「連立政権は、経済成長、雇用の安定、社会的結束をアジェンダの中心に据えることで合意した」、「われわれはわが国の民主主義が歴史的な試練に直面していることを認識している」と記されている。

メルツ首相やクリングバイル財務相ら連立政権上層部は、７日夜に首相官邸で政策について協議。メッセージによると、この会合は「良好かつ建設的な雰囲気」の中で行われた。

item.title: 中国の海上民兵船、台湾東岸沖で初確認 海警局と活動＝報告書
item.description:
Yimou Lee
[台北 ８日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Yimou Lee

[台北 ８日 ロイター] - 台湾の太平洋側の沖合で８月、中国の海上民兵船１隻が活動していたことが、ロイターが確認した監視報告書で分かった。安全保障上重要なこの海域で海上民兵船が確認されたのは初めて。

台湾の安捷航空（エイペックス・アビエーション）の報告書によると、この船は中国の海上民兵船を兼ねる漁船で、８月中旬に中国海警局の巡視船と調査船と共に活動していた。

台湾国防部（国防省）は報告書について、ロイターに「（中国は）法執行や科学調査を隠れみのに威嚇を行い、紛争が起きていない状況で活動範囲を広げ、事実上の管轄権があるかのように見せかけようとしている」と述べた。

こうした行動は国際秩序を損ない、台湾の海洋権益を脅かすと指摘。台湾軍は海巡署などの関係機関と連携し、偵察機器を使って中国の活動を追跡しているとした。

中国の国務院台湾事務弁公室と国防省はコメントの要請に応じていない。

中国の海上民兵は１９５０年代から存在し、南シナ海でより頻繁に確認されている。領有権が争われる海域で活動するための訓練や支援を受けた乗組員が漁船を操り、海警局の船と行動を共にすることが多い。

台湾政府高官２人によると、台湾側は８月中旬、この漁船が中国海警局の巡視船、調査船と共に台湾近海で活動していたことを確認した。

高官の１人は、この漁船を中国人民解放軍の海上民兵船団の一部と特定したと説明。台湾が追跡していたもので、「海警局による海上での威嚇訓練と連携して」活動していたと述べた。「民兵船の目的は、実際に嫌がらせ行為を行うことだ」と語った。

もう１人の高官によると、この３隻は「中国の船舶が通常あまり利用しない海域」で活動しており、「厳重な監視の対象」に指定されていた。

item.title: 中国・香港株式市場・大引け＝下落、連休明けの中国は1年ぶり安値
item.description: [上海 ８日 ロイター] - 中国・香港株式市場は下落。１週間近くの国慶節の連休明けとなった中国本土の主要指数は、地政学...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
中国・香港株式市場・大引け＝下落、連休明けの中国は1年ぶり安値 17:48 配信

[上海 ８日 ロイター] - 中国・香港株式市場は下落。１週間近くの国慶節の連休明けとなった中国本土の主要指数は、地政学的緊張の再燃、世界的な利回り上昇で１年ぶりの安値を付けた。

中国の主要株価指数は現在、２年前の水準付近にある。当時は中国政府の大型景気刺激策が株価を押し上げ、緩やかな強気相場への期待が高まっていたが、足元では３カ月にわたり下落基調が続いている。

大型株で構成するＣＳＩ３００指数は１．１％安で終了。２０２５年８月以来の安値を付け、６月のピークから約１５％下落している。

上海総合指数は０．８％下落、ハイテク株中心の上海証券取引所の新興ハイテク企業向け市場「科創板」５０指数は５％近く急落し、５カ月ぶりの安値を付けた。

香港市場では、中国の連休中に２％近く下落したハンセン指数がこの日１．４％下落し、３カ月ぶりの安値を付けた。

上海卓鋳投資のパートナーは、上半期に半導体メーカーなどの「ハードテック」銘柄への過度な楽観が広がり、バリュエーションが不合理な水準まで押し上げられたと指摘。その上で、「バブルはいずれ必ず崩壊する」と述べた。

科創板５０指数は７月１日以降、時価総額の３分の１超を失ったが、株価収益率（ＰＥＲ）は依然として約１００倍となっている。

リスク選好度は、先月の首脳会談による楽観ムードが薄れ、米中間の緊張が再燃したことでも抑制された。

台湾の駐米大使に相当する人物は７日、先月のトランプ米大統領と習近平国家主席の首脳会談後も米国との関係は依然として強固だと述べた。

米連邦通信委員会（ＦＣＣ）は７日、中国の全ての試験機関が米国で使用される電子機器の試験を行うことを禁止する案を１０月２９日に採決すると発表した。これにより、これまでの中国を標的とした措置が拡大することになる。

トレーダーはまた、今月予定されている中国と欧州連合（ＥＵ）の通商協議にも注目している。中国はハイブリッド車輸出の自主規制というＥＵの要請を拒否したと伝えられている。

中信建投証券は、利回り格差の拡大が資本流出を誘発するため「米３０年債利回りの急速な上昇は中国株を引き続き抑制する」と指摘した。

８日の中国市場ではハイテク株が下げを主導し、半導体、バイオテクノロジー、ロボットの各指数はいずれも４％以上下落した。

一方、エネルギー、不動産、銀行は上昇、成長株から景気循環セクターに乗り換えが進んでいることを示した。

香港市場では、ハンセンテック指数が３％下落し、２年ぶりの安値を付けた。

ロイター 関連ニュース 焦点：中国肝いりの物流情報網、忽然と姿消す　「通商上の兵器」と米が危惧 コラム：進む米中デカップリング、中国「保有米国債」の脅威減退か コラム：中国政府、株市場てこ入れ作戦に公的年金基金も動員 焦点：中国株、ＧＤＰ発表後も買い不発　不動産低迷で慎重ムード コラム：経済モデル転換目指す中国、不動産不況でも資源需要衰えず 最終更新: 10/8(木) 17:48 ロイター

item.title: ＷＨＯ事務局長選に宋莉氏擁立、中国正式発表「多国間主義支持」
item.description: [北京 ８日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[北京 ８日 ロイター] - 中国外務省は８日、世界保健機関（ＷＨＯ）の次期事務局長選に向けた候補者として、母子保健政策と国際協力の分野で２０年の経験を持つ公衆衛生当局高官の宋莉氏を擁立すると正式発表した。ロイターの報道が裏付けられた。

同省の毛寧報道官は記者団に対し、もし選出されれば、宋氏はＷＨＯが全人類の健康と福祉の向上においてより積極的な役割を果たす一助になると考えていると説明。「擁立は多国間主義に対する中国の確固たる支持を示すものだ」と付け加えた。

item.title: French teens march for decent schools despite government's pledge to act
item.description: French teenagers blockaded some high schools and marched through cities on Thursday as the government promised to address their grievances about teacher shortages and dilapidated school buildings but gave few specific details.
item.dc:creator: Manon Cruz, Dominique Vidalon
item.content:encoded: French teenagers blockaded some high schools and marched through cities on Thursday as the government promised to address their grievances about teacher shortages and dilapidated school buildings but gave few specific details. The protest movement, now into its third week, has exposed deep tensions in France between popular demands for investments in deteriorating public services and a cash-strapped government under [USN:L8N45S1P0 TEXT:"pressure from bond markets"] to reduce its debt and deficit. High-school teacher Diane Di Sciullo joined students at a large march in Marseille, saying all they were asking for was a decent education in decent conditions. She denounced overcrowding, saying this year she had 37 students in her class. "At the start of every lesson, I have to ask them to check the neighbouring classrooms for spare chairs and desks so they can actually study," she said. Di Sciullo, 28, was carrying a placard that read "I'm a teacher and my students help me catch cockroaches in class." MINISTER PROMISES URGENT ACTION Education ministry figures showed the number of school blockades was gradually decreasing. It said 224 were closed in the morning, down to 157 by lunchtime, meaning that 96% of schools were open. Scuffles between police and protesters took place at some blockade locations in Paris. Large crowds demonstrated across the country from Lille in the north to Rennes and Nantes in the west, the capital Paris, and Toulon and Marseille in the south. Education Minister Edouard Geffray held a meeting with students and teachers at a high school in the eastern city of Reims. "I am currently implementing an emergency plan to ensure that absent teachers can be replaced on a long-term basis," he said afterwards, adding that heavy school timetables were also under review. It is not uncommon for French teenagers to have lessons from 8 a.m. to 6 p.m., as well as large amounts of homework. HUNDREDS OF ARRESTS Geffray also said he was working on potential improvements to Parcoursup, the national online portal for applying to university, which has been widely criticised as confusing and stressful for applicants. Prime Minister Sebastien Lecornu pledged late on Wednesday that the government would present "concrete, quick and fully funded responses" to the protests by late October, without offering specifics. A prominent complaint featured on banners and placards was that the police response to the wave of protests has been too heavy-handed. "Too young to be listened to, old enough to be tear-gassed" was one example. There have been hundreds of arrests and dozens of injuries since the movement started. On Wednesday, the government [USN:L1N45T0EM TEXT:"suspended the use of stun grenades"] in the policing of the protests after one [USN:L1N45R08Q TEXT:"teenager's hand was blown off"]. POLARISED POLITICAL RESPONSE AS ELECTION LOOMS Six months out from an election to replace President Emmanuel Macron after the end of his second consecutive term, politicians' responses to the wave of student protests have been starkly polarised. Far-right frontrunner Marine Le Pen has highlighted damage to schools caused by a minority of protesters and called for them or their parents to foot repair bills. On Tuesday, she outlined [USN:L8N45R1J6 TEXT:"plans to slash public spending"] should she win. Her hard-left opponent Jean-Luc Melenchon, who also has a chance of making the runoff, has praised the protesters as "incredible" and denounced police brutality. According to an Elabe poll for BFM TV, 72% of French people think the students' demands are legitimate, but 55% of them think the protests should stop. The government has sought to tread a line between condemning violent incidents in which schools were set ablaze and staff injured, while also expressing sympathy with some of the students' complaints. STUDENTS PROTEST IN BELGIUM TOO On Thursday, student protests were also taking place in the Belgian cities of Brussels, Ciney and Liege. Grievances included rising costs, overcrowded classrooms, limited resources and increased teacher workloads. In Liege, where police said almost 200 arrests had been made in connection with student protests this month, authorities have imposed a ban on public gatherings of more than three people until October 16. However, police said a gathering in front of the city's university had been authorised.

item.title: ＦＲＢは追加利上げ必要、連続して行う必要なし＝ウォラー理事
item.description:
Howard Schneider
[ワシントン ８日 ロイター] - 米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）のウォラー理事は８日、...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＦＲＢは追加利上げ必要、連続して行う必要なし＝ウォラー理事 17:31 配信

写真は米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）のウォラー理事。9月3日、ワシントンで撮影。REUTERS/Kylie Cooper

Howard Schneider

[ワシントン ８日 ロイター] - 米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）のウォラー理事は８日、インフレ率をＦＲＢの目標である２％まで引き下げるには、追加の利上げが必要になる可能性が高いと述べた。しかし、利上げのペースについては「柔軟性」があり、１０月２７─２８日の米連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）で利上げをいったん見送る可能性も残した。

イスタンブールで開催されたトルコ中央銀行のフォーラムでの講演原稿によると、ウォラー氏は「経済データが予想通りに推移し続けるならば、インフレ率を目標の２％に早期に戻すために、追加利上げを実施すると予想している」と発言。

その上で「利上げの実施時期についてはある程度の柔軟性がある。利上げは連続した会合で実施する必要はなく、妥当な期間内に実施されるべきだ」と語った。

ウォラー氏の発言は、他のＦＲＢ当局者がここ数日に示した見解に重なるものであり、１０月のＦＯＭＣではフェデラルファンド（ＦＦ）金利誘導目標を現在の３．７５─４％に据え置く可能性が高いことを示唆している。１２月の利上げについては、新たな経済データが引き続き低い失業率と成長の継続を示す一方、インフレ抑制の進展が限定的あるいは全く見られない場合に行われる可能性があるとしている。

ＦＲＢは９月にＦＦ金利誘導目標を０．２５％ポイント引き上げたが、同時に発表された予測によると、ほとんどのＦＲＢ当局者は年末までにさらに０．２５％ポイントの利上げを予想している。

投資家は現在、ＦＲＢが１０月のＦＯＭＣ（米中間選挙のわずか１週間前）ではＦＦ金利を据え置くものの、その６週間後の１２月８─９日のＦＯＭＣでは利上げに踏み切ると見ている。

ウォラー氏は、現在ＦＲＢの目標を１％ポイント以上上回っているインフレ率を引き下げるために、ＦＦ金利をどれだけ追加で引き上げる必要があると考えているかについては言及しなかった。

同氏は、経済が回復し、イラン戦争によるエネルギー価格ショックが依然として解決されていないこと、そして人工知能（ＡＩ）の発展が主要な商品やサービスへの需要増加を通じてインフレを加速させているという新たな懸念があることから、金利引き上げの必要性が明確になったと説明した。

同氏は「今年後半に経済活動が強化されているという証拠があるため、金融引き締め政策が経済の深刻な減速を招く恐れがあるとは、それほど懸念していない」とした上で、「最近のインフレ加速は、消費者、投資家、そして価格決定権を持つ企業が将来のインフレ期待を上方修正するきっかけとなるのではないかと懸念している」と述べた。

ここ数日で、最終的に追加利上げの必要が生じる可能性を残しつつも、その前に様子を見る意向を示したＦＲＢ高官はウォラー氏で３人目。投資家はこのメッセージを、次回のＦＯＭＣへの期待値を設定する際に考慮に入れているようだ。

ＦＲＢ議長に就任する際、今後の政策決定について多くを語ることを避けたいと述べていたウォーシュ氏は、何もコメントしていない。

だが、ウォラー氏らは議論を続けている。ウォラー氏は８日の発言の中で、他のＦＲＢ高官らの最近の発言が特定の成果を約束することなく、金利の推移に関する市場の確率設定にどのように役立ったかを説明した。これは、投資家が全くシグナルを受け取れない場合に起こりうる変動を回避できる、より良い政策決定手法だと主張した。

同氏は、政策立案者は「最終的な目的地が決まっていないことを認めつつ、今後どのような方向に向かう可能性が高いかを示すことができる」と述べ、「このシグナルは短期金利の方向性を定めるのに役立つ一方で、今後のデータに基づいて利上げを調整する柔軟性も提供する」と語った。

ウォラー氏は、ＦＲＢの政策に関する情報発信を完全に停止することは賢明ではないと主張している。

item.title: Poland's second school knife attack in two days kills one, raises copycat fears
item.description: A 15-year-old former pupil killed one employee and injured two others at a Polish primary school on Thursday wearing a helmet-mounted camera, the second school stabbing in two days, possibly in response to an internet challenge, authorities said.
item.dc:creator: Kuba Stezycki, Kacper Pempel
item.content:encoded: A 15-year-old former pupil killed one employee and injured two others at a Polish primary school on Thursday wearing a helmet-mounted camera, the second school stabbing in two days, possibly in response to an internet challenge, authorities said. A 37-year-old woman who worked as a caretaker had died in the latest attack, which took place at around 9 a.m. (0700 GMT) in Leszczydol-Nowiny, northeast of Warsaw, officials said. On Wednesday, a 19-year-old [USN:L1N45T0N9 TEXT:"wounded 10 people"] including himself at another school in Ostroleka, northeastern Poland, and police detained a 17-year-old in Sierpc in north-central Poland on suspicion of planning an attack. "We fear a grim copycat phenomenon," Prime Minister Donald Tusk told an emergency meeting. "We are facing an extraordinary situation... for the first time, we are dealing with a killer who wore a helmet-mounted camera, intending to film the knife attack." It was not clear whether the attack was actually filmed. He ordered police to visit schools daily in an effort to prevent further violence. A police spokesperson said authorities had information that the incidents could be related to an internet challenge and that this was being investigated. TEACHERS INJURED RESTRAINING ATTACKER Tusk praised the heroism of two teachers at the school who were injured as they tried to stop the attacker. Head teacher Krzysztof Ochmanski said he had heard a scream and ran into the corridor. "He wounded me with the blade of a rather long knife - he had three knives on him - and hit me with the handle," he told the public broadcaster Polskie Radio RDC. "By then, I had managed to restrain him." A Reuters reporter saw an air ambulance flying away from the school, where a small crowd had gathered. The father of one child, waiting outside the school, said pupils had not yet been allowed to leave, but were safe. Footage on public news broadcaster TVP Info showed what appeared to be the attacker being handcuffed and put into a police van. Inspector Katarzyna Nowak, director of communications for national police, said serious offenders were becoming younger across Europe. "Over the past few months in Poland, we have seen arrests of teenagers who were preparing to carry out attacks ... So, this is indeed a problem we face, and one we must acknowledge," she told TVP Info. Interior minister Marcin Kierwinski said that the 17-year-old detained in Sierpc had mentioned plans to do "something dangerous" on school grounds. "Data recovered from electronic devices revealed online searches regarding how to orchestrate such a violent event," Kierwinski said. Police found two knives in his possession.

item.title: ＥＣＢ最低準備率引き上げに反対、信頼低下招く＝ベルギー中銀総裁
item.description: [フランクフルト ８日 ロイター] - 欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）理事会メンバーのウンシュ・ベルギー中央銀行総裁は、民間銀...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＥＣＢ最低準備率引き上げに反対、信頼低下招く＝ベルギー中銀総裁 17:12 配信

写真は欧州中央銀行（ECB）本部の看板。2018年4月、フランクフルトで撮影。REUTERS/Kai Pfaffenbach

[フランクフルト ８日 ロイター] - 欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）理事会メンバーのウンシュ・ベルギー中央銀行総裁は、民間銀行に義務付ける法定準備預金の比率を引き上げる案に反対した。将来の政策運営に対する信頼を損ない、財政政策の領域に踏み込む恐れもあると警告した。

ＥＣＢ内では現在、銀行が無利子で預け入れる法定準備預金の割合を引き上げるべきかどうかが議論されている。ＥＣＢ自身の損失を減らすとともに、高インフレ下で金融環境を一段と引き締める狙いがある。

ウンシュ氏はブリュッセルでの会議で「（法定準備預金の）最低準備率引き上げについて、現在議論が進んでいる。もちろん引き続き利息を付けないという前提だ」と説明。「率直に言って、その理屈は私にはあまり明確ではなく、説得力があるとも思えない」と述べた。

ＥＣＢは新型コロナ禍前の金利がゼロ以下だった時期に、債券買い入れを通じて数兆ユーロの余剰流動性を生み出した。現在は商業銀行がこの資金をＥＣＢに預け入れ、ＥＣＢは多額の利払いを強いられている。このため中央銀行の損失が膨らんでいる。

ウンシュ氏は「損失を抑えることが目的なら、最低準備率は財政政策に近い手段になる」と指摘。「通常、財政政策は中央銀行に与えられた役割ではない」と述べた。

また、こうした措置で銀行の利子収入が減れば、将来の債券買い入れ策への参加に銀行が消極的になる恐れがあり、中央銀行の政策運営に対する信頼を損ないかねないと述べた。

ロイター 関連ニュース アングル：ＥＣＢ「予防的」追加利上げへ、米イラン紛争長期化で アングル：ＥＣＢ、金利据え置きへ　原油価格が再び焦点 アングル：ＡＩの経済金融への影響、ＥＣＢフォーラムで希望と懸念が交錯 アングル：金融市場はＥＣＢのタカ派化見込む、イラン戦による油価高騰で コラム：求むＥＣＢ総裁、危機に強い革新者 最終更新: 10/8(木) 18:56 ロイター

Oct 8 : Hedge fund WorldQuant said on Wednesday registrations for this year's flagship global quant research contest have almost doubled from a year earlier, as increased adoption of AI has helped more university students build trading models. Here are more details: • The International Quant Championship, run by WorldQuant, a spin-off of Millennium Management, challenges entrants to build mathematical models that forecast price movements across a range of financial instruments • About 156,000 people signed up this year, compared with roughly 80,000 in 2025, the firm said

item.title: Most Gulf bourses end lower as Hormuz attacks hit wartime peak
item.description: Most Gulf stock markets closed lower on Thursday as tanker attacks in the Strait of Hormuz hit a wartime high, deadly strikes on Saudi airports widened the conflict and stalled US-Iran diplomacy offered investors little relief.
item.dc:creator: Ateeq Shariff
item.content:encoded: Most Gulf stock markets closed lower on Thursday as tanker attacks in the Strait of Hormuz [USN:L1N45T0HL TEXT:"hit a wartime high"], deadly [USN:L1N45U0A3 TEXT:"strikes on Saudi airports"] widened the conflict and stalled US-Iran diplomacy offered investors little relief. The latest attack came on Wednesday, when a tanker was [USN:S8N4320AR TEXT:"hit by multiple projectiles"] 51 nautical miles north of Qatar's Madinat ash Shamal, causing casualties, according to the United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations (UKMTO). The [USN:L1N45U0E0 TEXT:"surge in attacks"] came just as Gulf producers were pushing to export more. Saudi Arabia's benchmark index (.TASI) ended a sixth consecutive week in the red after falling 1.6%, its biggest one-day decline since March. Saudi National Bank (1180.SE) , the country's largest lender by assets, lost 3.1%. Shipping traffic quickly took the hit. The number of vessels passing through the Strait of Hormuz [USN:L1N45U01Q TEXT:"fell to its lowest in more than two months"], shipping data showed, though Gulf oil exports [USN:L1N45R04U TEXT:"have recovered"]. A US response over a plan to [USN:S8N43Z009 TEXT:"reopen the Strait of Hormuz"] within seven days is still under review in Tehran. The violence also spread beyond the sea. Saudi Arabia's civil aviation authorities said on Wednesday that three people had been killed in [USN:L1N45T00S TEXT:"attacks on the kingdom's airports"], as fighting intensified in Yemen between the Iran-aligned Houthis and Saudi-backed government forces. That added to the risks facing Gulf markets. In Abu Dhabi, the index (.FTFADGI) lost 1.6%, while Dubai's main share index (.DFMGI) shed 1.7%. Investors stayed cautious amid regional tensions and stalled diplomacy, according to Mahmoud Mashal, senior market analyst at VT Markets in Dubai. Reports of a possible resumption of attacks weighed on sentiment and cast doubt on US-Iran talks, he said, while repeated tanker strikes and disruption at major maritime chokepoints kept worries alive as traffic fell. Qatar's benchmark index (.QSI) sank to its lowest level since the pandemic-driven selloff of June 2020, closing down 2.2%. The biggest drag was a 2.9% slide in Qatar National Bank (QNB) (QNBK.QA) , the Gulf's largest lender. Post trading hours, QNB reported third-quarter net profit of 4.65 billion riyals ($1.28 billion), up from 4.43 billion riyals a year earlier. The Egyptian bourse was closed for a public holiday. Saudi Arabia (.TASI) fell 1.6% to 10,376 Abu Dhabi (.FTFADGI) dropped 1.6% to 9,801 Dubai (.DFMGI) declined 1.7% to 5,799 Qatar (.QSI) retreated 2.2% to 9,006 Bahrain (.BAX) eased 0.2% to 1,896 Oman (.MSX30) added 0.1% to 7,832 Kuwait (.BKP) down 0.4% to 9,032 ($1 = 3.6450 Qatar riyals)

Dollar creeps towards 18-month high, euro lags as bond yields rise again

An employee holds U.S. dollar bank notes at a money changer in Jakarta, Indonesia, April 9, 2025. REUTERS/Willy Kurniawan/File Photo

FAST

LONDON, Oct 8 : The dollar rose towards its strongest level in 18 months on Thursday, after minutes from the US Federal Reserve signalled policymakers viewed inflation as the biggest risk to their outlook, while higher oil prices and rising euro zone bond yields have weighed on the euro. The global bond selloff has been the dominant driver in currency markets in recent weeks, with yields rising again on Thursday as oil prices jumped.  The widening gap in yields between German bonds and those of more indebted countries in the euro zone, such as France and Italy, has pushed the euro to its lowest level since May last year.  French government bonds have come under particular selling pressure due to worries about France's deteriorating fiscal situation ahead of next year's presidential election.

"If you look at euro-dollar, it's not only about dollar strength but euro weakness coming from the political situation in France," said Tommy von Brömsen, FX strategist at Handelsbanken.  The euro was down 0.2 per cent on Thursday at $1.1174, close to its lowest level in 17 months, as the spread between German and French 10-year yields, a market gauge of risk premium attached to France, widened by 5 basis points.    The dollar index, which measures its strength against a basket of six currencies, including the euro, was up 0.2 per cent at 102.40 after rising 0.4 per cent on Wednesday. The US currency remains within a few pips of its strongest levels since April 9, 2025, following the market turmoil that accompanied US President Donald Trump's so-called Liberation Day tariff announcement the previous week. FED MINUTES Fed policymakers voted unanimously to raise interest rates by a quarter of a percentage point at the US central bank's September 15-16 meeting. The minutes from that meeting released on Wednesday indicated that policy might need to be tightened further.  "There was no major surprise, but I think they were on the hawkish side," said Handelsbanken's von Brömsen.  The minutes did little to shift expectations that the Fed would stand pat at its meeting later this month. Fed funds futures are pricing an implied 80 per cent probability the US central bank will keep rates on hold at its next two-day meeting ending October 28, while a hike in December is fully priced in, according to LSEG data. Against the yen, the US dollar was up 0.1 per cent at 158.27, reversing a short-lived dip after data released on Thursday showed Japan's current account surplus stood at 4.062 trillion yen ($25.7 billion) in August, higher than economists' median forecast for a surplus of 3.19 trillion yen.  The Australian dollar was down 0.3 per cent at $0.6943, while its kiwi counterpart was down 0.2 per cent at $0.5588. Against the Chinese yuan, the US dollar was flat at 6.7050 in offshore trade.

Source: Reuters

item.title: Drones, explosions and soldiers in bulldozers: surrounded by Israelis in Lebanon's 'model town'
item.description: Israeli troops withdrew from West Zawtar in July, the first test of a US-backed "pilot zone" plan for Israel to withdraw gradually from southern Lebanon. But two months on, residents say their village is no blueprint.
item.dc:creator: Maya Gebeily, Emilie Madi, Mohamed Azakir
item.content:encoded: Dodging the broken glass carpeting her home in southern Lebanon, Mariam al-Yaghi exited onto her upper balcony and pointed. A few hundred metres away was a sight the 67-year-old had grown accustomed to: military vehicles moving through the adjacent Lebanese village, still occupied by Israeli troops. At night, Israeli soldiers patrol so close to Yaghi's home in West Zawtar that she can hear their voices. By day, she is often trailed by a small Israeli surveillance drone as she toils in her garden. Booms echo throughout the morning as Israel's military [USN:L6N40J1HB TEXT:"destroys homes"] in the surrounding occupied towns with controlled detonations and bulldozers. "We hear them all the time from that house over there with the tile roof. We hear their voices yelling, the tanks when they move this way and that way. We hear all of that. They’re very close to us, but we’re sitting here and we’re not scared. Never," Yaghi told Reuters. Israeli troops withdrew from West Zawtar in July, the [USN:L6N43T0O3 TEXT:"first test"] of a US-backed [USN:L8N4310HK TEXT:""pilot zone" plan"] for Israel to withdraw gradually from southern Lebanon, in exchange for the disarmament of the Iranian-backed militant group Hezbollah. But two months on, no further "pilot zones" have been agreed and residents of West Zawtar say their village is no blueprint. In response to questions from Reuters, the Israeli military said work to remove the threat of Hezbollah's weapons had not been completed. Drones were used to identify threats, and restrictions on movement of local villagers were intended to protect troops. A US State Department spokesperson said the pilot zone process was "the only viable path" to security for both Lebanon and Israel. The zone would expand after the Lebanese army carried out clearance operations in the initial zone, and Hezbollah's disarmament "is an integral part of this process." FRONT-ROW SEAT TO DESTRUCTION Beginning seven months ago, more than a million Lebanese fled their homes when Israel launched air strikes and a [USN:L1N42O0YT TEXT:"ground invasion"] in parallel with the war in Iran, after the armed group Hezbollah fired into Israel in solidarity with Tehran. Ending the Lebanon conflict has been an Iranian condition for any peace deal, prompting Washington to press for an accord. But despite months of US-brokered talks between Lebanon and Israel and a ceasefire agreed in June, Israel's military has continued [USN:L6N44Z08Z TEXT:"deadly strikes"]. Its troops still occupy a self-declared [USN:L1N42Q07D TEXT:"security zone"] that includes dozens of Lebanese villages, many of which the Israelis have demolished. Residents of West Zawtar say their return home in July was bittersweet: they were happy to be back, but found homes in ruins and Israeli troops uncomfortably close. A tank shell had crashed into the upper floor of Yaghi's home and all the windows had been blown out. Another had pierced her water tank's roof, turning the water inside blood-red. Repairs will be costly, so Yaghi has delayed them for now. "We’ve put up cardboard and stuff like that because there’s no glass. My other son too, all the glass and everything is gone. But here we are… until they get the hell out of here," she said, gesturing towards the Israeli troops in the adjacent village. Few of Yaghi's neighbours have returned so far, as their homes had been pulverized. Tank tracks ran through her garden, where olive trees she had nurtured for decades lay uprooted. With the harvest beginning, Yaghi was excited to pick whatever remained. People whose groves lie near Israeli troop positions said they were requesting access to their trees through a US-led coordination mechanism between the Lebanese and Israeli militaries. Some mocked the absurdity of asking Washington for permission to pick olives. Others feared approval would come too late for the harvest. Just down the road from West Zawtar lies its twin village, East Zawtar, still occupied by Israeli troops who have been systematically demolishing it. Displaced East Zawtar residents came to West Zawtar, where they sat on white plastic chairs in the main square with a front-row view of their home town across a small valley of olive groves and farmland. One man told Reuters he had seen lights on in his own house over the last three weeks, and expected Israeli troops were laying explosives to detonate it. "You try not to be upset, because it's happened to so many people. But all it takes is one memory from the house, and you break down," he said. ISRAELI TROOPS GONE, BUT KEEPING WATCH West Zawtar's mayor, Abed Ezzedine, told Reuters the "pilot zone" programme had not worked, primarily because public services including electricity and running water were still largely unavailable. "In principle, I can tell you that no, it’s not successful. Based on what we were promised: that West Zawtar as a pilot zone would be a model town," Ezzedine said. Some 70 families had returned, mostly living in corners of their homes that had not been damaged. For many, it was a better option than paying rent elsewhere or living in a displacement shelter. The Lebanese state's Council for the South has delivered 16 prefabricated houses to families whose homes were uninhabitable. But most of the pre-fab dwellings are still unoccupied, with no access to electricity or water. State workers are beginning to extend electrical lines, but have had to run them further to a new station, as the village's old connection ran through East Zawtar. "In a little bit, the drone might fly over people in the town square. It's not leaving anyone alone," Ezzedine said. Sure enough, a few moments later, a small surveillance drone flew over Ezzedine and a team of Reuters reporters, gradually dropping altitude until it was just a few meters overhead. It hovered for a few minutes, before flying towards the occupied neighbouring village.

item.content:encoded:
テルモ、975億円の損失で業績下方修正　米社との供給契約解除で 16:56 配信

Kentaro Okasaka

[東京 ８日 ロイター] - テルモは８日、米拠点のＣＳＬプラズマとの血漿（けっしょう）採取システム供給契約を解除することを決めたと発表した。財務影響額は、現時点で総額約６．１億ドル（約９７５億円）の損失となる見込み。これに伴い、２０２７年３月期の連結純利益予想を従来の１９３１億円から１２００億円に下方修正した。

損失額のうち約７２０億円は米生産拠点の製造設備、機械装置、製品技術などの関連資産に関わる減損損失。残りは移行期間中の事業損失や事業再編などに伴う費用という。

item.content:encoded:
地政学的ショック、金融面にも波及＝仏中銀総裁 16:50 配信

欧州中央銀行（ECB）理事会メンバーのムーラン仏中銀総裁。6月9日、パリで撮影。REUTERS/Sarah Meyssonnier

[フランクフルト ８日 ロイター] - 欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）理事会メンバーのムーラン仏中銀総裁は８日、今年の欧州のインフレショックはほぼ全てエネルギーに関連しているが、価格急騰を招いた地政学的ショックが今や金融面にも波及しているとの見解を示した。

イスタンブールで開かれた会議で「地政学的ショックが金融ショックにもつながりつつある」と指摘した。「原油、米国の長期金利、欧州の金利には強い相関関係があり、金利上昇が金融環境に影響を及ぼしている」と述べた。

item.title: 国内大手金融5社トップ、金利上昇を前向き評価 財政懸念も指摘
item.description:
Miho Uranaka
[東京 ８日 ロイター] - 三井住友フィナンシャルグループ（ＳＭＦＧ）などの大手金融機関５...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
国内大手金融5社トップ、金利上昇を前向き評価　財政懸念も指摘 16:41 配信

日本のメガバンクの看板。2018年4月3日、都内で撮影。 REUTERS/Toru Hanai 現在値 三菱ＵＦＪ 3,504 -118 Miho Uranaka

[東京 ８日 ロイター] - 三井住友フィナンシャルグループ（ＳＭＦＧ）などの大手金融機関５社のトップは８日、日本経済新聞社主催のシンポジウムに出席し、国内の金利上昇について、企業の設備投資や経済成長を反映した動きだとして前向きな評価を示した。ただ、財政懸念などによる「悪い金利上昇というような要素も入っている」（ＳＭＦＧ中島達社長）との指摘もあった。株式市場については強気な見方が多かった。

三菱ＵＦＪフィナンシャル・グループ ＜ 8306.T ＞ の半沢淳一社長は、日本経済は長年のデフレ状態から「物価、賃金、経済活動がある意味正常化する局面」にまで進んだと指摘。「経済の実力や物価上昇率の高まりに見合った金利上昇であれば、経済正常化の一環として前向きに捉えるべきだ」と述べた。一方、物価上昇や日銀の利上げ観測に加え、財政の持続可能性に対する市場の見方を背景としたリスクプレミアムの上昇も一部反映されているとの認識を示した。

中島氏も現在の金利上昇について「概ね良い金利上昇の結果」と評価。同時に、「日本の財政が将来にわたって、しっかり健全性が維持されるのかと懸念を抱いている投資家も、やはり一定はいる」と述べた。財政懸念に加え、中東情勢を巡るリスクも一部金利に織り込まれているという。

今後のリスクとして、みずほフィナンシャルグループの木原正裕社長は、各国政府の財政拡張や人工知能（ＡＩ）・データセンター分野を中心とした旺盛な投資需要を背景に長期資金の獲得競争が起きていることを挙げた。「長期金利が高騰しやすい環境」とみて、低格付け企業への影響を注視しているという。中東情勢の悪化による原油調達コスト上昇の影響も、国内経済にとって「非常に心配だ」と述べた。

中島氏は、米国を中心とするＡＩ向けデータセンター投資について、「将来しっかりキャッシュフローを生むのか若干疑問を呈する投資家も出てきている」と指摘。その上で、「投資がスローダウンするようなことがあれば、世界経済に相当大きなインパクトをもたらす」と警戒感を示した。ただ、国内企業の資金需要は依然として強いという。

株式市場の先行きについては、総じて強気な見方が多い。野村ホールディングスの奥田健太郎社長は好調な企業業績やガバナンス改革を背景に「海外投資家の日本株への関心は高い」と指摘し、日経平均は年末にかけて７万５０００円前後、２０２７年末には８万円超も視野に入ると見込む。

大和証券グループ本社の荻野明彦社長はさらに強気で、年末８万円、２７年末に８万８０００円に達する可能性があると予想。日本株の評価見直しは中長期的に続くとの見方から、２０４５年には３０万円に到達する可能性にも言及した。ただ、地政学や金融政策を巡る不確実性そのものよりも、「市場のボラティリティーが過度に上昇することが一番のリスク」という。

item.title: 中国、開発機関への拠出急増 影響力は追い付かず＝報告書
item.description:
Andrea Shalal
[ワシントン ８日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Andrea Shalal

[ワシントン ８日 ロイター] - 中国は２０１０年以降、多国間開発機関への拠出を大幅に増やした一方、国際機関での議決権や幹部ポストの数は世界第２位の経済規模に見合っていないことがシンクタンクの報告書で明らかになった。

世界開発センターが８日発表した報告書によると、中国の開発銀行への資金拠出額は２４年に３０億ドルに達し、国連の開発関連機関への拠出は４７％増加した。

中国は多国間の気候変動対策への拠出も２５年に５２億５０００万ドルへと大幅に増やした。一方、低所得国向けにワクチンを調達・供給する官民連携組織「Ｇａｖｉワクチンアライアンス」などの基金への拠出は３２％削減した。

報告書の共著者イアン・ミッチェル氏は、中国の資金拠出について「１５年前から大きく増えたが、経済規模に比べれば依然としてごくわずかだ」と述べ、中国は拠出先をかなり選別していると指摘した。

同氏は「国連への自発的な拠出は多くない。特定分野に特化した基金への支援はほぼ皆無で、２国間の取り組みは続けているものの、規模は縮小している」と述べた。

共著者のベアタ・チホツカ氏は、米国が世界保健機関（ＷＨＯ）から脱退する一方、中国はＷＨＯに多額の拠出を行ってきたと述べた。ただ開発支出を削減した欧米諸国が残した空白を中国が全て埋めているわけではないとした。

報告書によると、最貧国を支援する世界銀行の国際開発協会（ＩＤＡ）に対し、中国は前回の増資で１５億ドルの拠出を表明し、現在は第５位の拠出国となっている。中国は過去５年間で、多国間開発銀行の無利子・低利融資プログラムへの拠出も９２％増やした。

中国の国連機関への拠出のうち、自発的な拠出が占める割合は１１％にとどまった。ミッチェル氏は、中国が戦略上何を重視しているかを端的に示すものだと指摘した。米国の拠出では、自発的な拠出が７０％を超えた。

報告書によると、世銀や他の多国間開発銀行では中国人が上級管理職のポストを五つ占めており、２１年以降変わっていない。一方、中国は２０年以降、ＷＨＯや国際電気通信連合（ＩＴＵ）など複数の国連機関で幹部ポストを失った。

高所得国に分類される段階に近づいている中国は、開発銀行からの借り入れを大幅に減らしている。報告書によると、借入総額は２１年の８０億ドルから２４年には４７億ドルに減少した。中国は１７年には世銀最大の借り入れ国だったが、現在は１８位となっている。

Oct 8 : Tencent is considering raising up to $5 billion via an offshore bond sale, Bloomberg News reported on Thursday, as the Chinese technology giant ramps up spending on AI and computing infrastructure in line with its peers. Here are the details: • The bonds could be issued in US dollars and offshore yuan, with a sale potentially happening early this month, the report said, citing people familiar with the matter. • The move follows Tencent's $4.66 billion bond offering in June, its largest debt deal since 2020.

item.title: 韓国、外国銀によるオフショア債発行アレンジの禁止検討＝関係筋
item.description:
Seunggyu Lim
[ソウル ８日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Seunggyu Lim

[ソウル ８日 ロイター] - 韓国は海外での債券発行が活況を呈する中、国内証券免許を持たない外国の投資銀行がオフショア債発行をアレンジすることを禁止する方向で検討している。財政経済省の関係筋が８日、ロイターに明らかにした。

同省が国内証券免許を持つ銀行から意見を集めており、近く正式な発表を行う予定だという。

同筋によると、海外での債券発行を多くアレンジしてきた無免許の投資銀行には、日本の三菱ＵＦＪフィナンシャル・グループ（ＭＵＦＧ）や豪ＡＮＺなどが含まれており、いずれも計画されている規制の対象となる見込み。現在、ＭＵＦＧもＡＮＺも韓国で証券免許を保有していないという。

ＭＵＦＧとＡＮＺはロイターのコメント要請に応じていない。

この規制に関する協議については、韓国メディア「ソウル経済」が６日に最初に報じていた。

聯合ニュースによると、主要引受会社は２０２６年上半期、韓国企業向けに総額５３１億ドルの外貨建て債券発行をアレンジ。海外資金調達需要が高まったことから、前年同期比で３３％増加した。

item.title: Indonesia committed to safeguarding all investments, president says
item.description: Indonesia has attracted massive investment into its metal industry and smelting, but recent policies have raised concerns from some business players.

item.content:encoded:

Indonesia committed to safeguarding all investments, president says

Indonesia has attracted massive investment into its metal industry and smelting, but recent policies have raised concerns from some business players.

In North Maluku's Weda Bay, a nickel rush has transformed quiet fishing villages into a giant industrial complex filled with refineries and coal-fired power plants. (Photo: CNA/Wisnu Agung Prasetyo)

FAST

JAKARTA: Indonesia's President Prabowo Subianto said on Thursday (Oct 8) his government is committed to respecting and safeguarding all investments in the country. Prabowo was speaking at a launch ceremony for commercial operations of four nickel facilities and construction of six projects in an industrial park at Weda Bay. "I emphasise here an Indonesian government commitment to respect and safeguard all investments, from wherever," he said. "We are committed to safeguarding our partnership as well as possible. It is a matter of honour for the Indonesian people to support our partners."
